View manifest View in Mirador Viewer Expand to view image × Description Description: The Houston Oilers were a founding franchise in the American Football League (1960), joining the the National Football League when the two Leagues merged in 1970. From 1968-1996 the team played in the Houston Astrodome, the world's first indoor domed Stadium. In 1997 the Oilers relocated to Nashville, becoming the Tennessee Titans.
